posts.zh:
dsh-vision-opencode 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-115b63ec9d8ac0173d45.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision-opencode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-115b63ec9d8ac0173d45.html
